shots.alt: A low, slow move along a lifted sidewalk panel on a Northwest Austin street in morning light.
shots.prompt: Slow, steady push-in low along the sidewalk toward the lifted panel. Camera otherwise locked, no shake. Soft morning light, leaves move slightly in a light breeze. The concrete, cracks and panel edges stay exactly as they are. No people, no vehicles moving.

shots.alt: A sidewalk that ends in worn dirt and grass, with the street running on beside it.
shots.prompt: Very slow push-in toward the point where the sidewalk ends. Camera otherwise locked. Grass moves slightly in a light breeze. The pavement and ground stay exactly as they are. No people, no vehicles moving.

shots.alt: A concrete sidewalk panel cracked through and lifted at one edge.
shots.prompt: Very slow push-in toward the cracked, lifted panel. Camera otherwise locked. Light shifts gently as if a cloud passes. The concrete and cracks stay exactly as they are. No people, no vehicles moving.

shots.alt: Tree roots heaving two sidewalk panels out of level.
shots.prompt: Slow lateral slide to the right past the root-heaved panels, small parallax. Camera height fixed. Dappled tree shade moves slightly. The concrete and roots stay exactly as they are. No people, no vehicles moving.

shots.alt: A hedge grown across half the width of a sidewalk.
shots.prompt: Very slow push-in along the sidewalk toward the overgrown hedge. Camera otherwise locked. Leaves move slightly in a light breeze. The sidewalk stays exactly as it is. No people, no vehicles moving.
